records.selection_reason: Second distinct hardware subject, so product-swap has a same-domain plausible confusion rather than a shoe-versus-kettle non-test. WINDOW REVISED AFTER MEASUREMENT: the first window (00:00:20) fell in the stills-and-animation portion of this media reel and measured 8 pre-existing freeze runs plus a black interval. Eight freezes in a freeze-detection base would make injected and pre-existing freezes indistinguishable. A second window (00:04:15) measured clean but frame inspection showed it holds only monochrome navigation-camera terrain, with no hardware in frame - clean, but no longer the product-swap subject this entry exists to supply. The third window (00:01:16) measures 0 freezes, 0 black frames and one scene change, and frame inspection confirms the helicopter is visible on the surface. Recorded in full because a clip that passes the mechanical screen can still fail the requirement, and only inspection catches that.
